newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia seeks more landing rights in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Malaysia seeks more landing rights in U.S..

text.p: Malaysia has asked for more landing rights in the United States and will hold negotiations on the matter with U.S. authorities next month, Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik said on Thursday.

If the proposal is accepted, national carrier Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS) is expected to fly to other destinations in the U.S., instead of only to Los Angeles now, Ling was quoted by the national Bernama news agency as telling reporters.

"Currently, if we want to go to New York or Chicago, we have to disembark in Los Angeles and take another flight to these cities," he said. Ling did not say how many times a week MAS currently lands in Los Angeles.
Ling said he had raised the landing rights issue with the U.S. Secretary of Transport recently.
"I told him that as Malaysia did not limit the landing rights of American airlines, it was unfair to limit Malaysia's landing rights," he said.
